Regarding the operational processes in the text, the primary bottleneck is the outdated First-In-First-Out (FIFO) storage system. This system creates inefficiency by placing newer stock behind older items, making access to recent inventory difficult and time-consuming. To improve efficiency, the warehouse should consider implementing a system that allows for easier access to newer stock, such as a dynamic slotting system or a different storage layout that does not strictly bury new items under old ones, thereby reducing the time spent on reorganization.
